results.title: General Manager – Land Transportation
results.description: Our client, a growing land transportation company based in Najran, Saudi Arabia, is seeking an entrepreneurial and commercially driven General Manager to lead the business through its next stage of growth. The role requires a business builder with a strong track record of growing and scaling transportation or logistics businesses. The successful candidate will have full responsibility for the company's strategic, commercial, operational, and financial performance, with a strong mandate to accelerate business development, market penetration, expansion, and modernization . Key Responsibilities Develop and execute a multi-year growth and expansion strategy to significantly strengthen the company's market position. Drive business development and market penetration through new customers, contracts, sectors, services, and strategic partnerships. Identify and evaluate opportunities for geographic expansion, service diversification, and fleet investment. Take full ownership of the company's P&L, revenue growth, profitability, cash flow, and overall business performance. Lead large-scale transportation and fleet operations, ensuring strong asset utilization, productivity, service reliability, and cost efficiency. Optimize fleet performance, maintenance, fuel consumption, route planning, capacity utilization, and operational KPIs. Lead commercial negotiations, contract pricing, customer management, and strategic account development. Drive the company's digitalization and modernization agenda , leveraging technology, data, automation, and modern transport/fleet management systems. Build scalable organizational structures, processes, systems, and capabilities to support rapid business growth. Build and develop a strong leadership team and establish a performance-driven, accountable organizational culture. Maintain strong relationships with customers, strategic partners, government entities, and other key stakeholders. Ensure appropriate governance, safety, risk management, and regulatory compliance as the organization expands. Candidate Profile Minimum 12 years of relevant experience , including at least 5 years in a senior leadership capacity . Strong background within land transportation, logistics, fleet management, or a closely related sector . Proven track record of growing, scaling, or significantly expanding a business , with tangible achievements in revenue growth, market penetration, new customer acquisition, or business expansion. Strong business development and commercial orientation combined with solid transportation and fleet operational expertise. Demonstrated P&L ownership and strong understanding of profitability, cost structures, investment decisions, and asset utilization. Experience leading sizeable operational workforces and multidisciplinary teams. Exposure to digital transformation, fleet technology, automation, or transportation management systems is highly desirable. Entrepreneurial, hands-on, and highly results-oriented leadership style. Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Finance, Logistics, or a related discipline; an MBA is preferred. Interested candidates with a demonstrated record of building and scaling transportation businesses are invited to apply or share their profile for confidential consideration.

results.title: Last Mile Operations Manager
results.location: Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
results.description: We operate autonomous delivery vehicles in the UAE. This role owns whether those deliveries actually land — on time, without failure, without a complaint. Once a customer is live and vehicles are on the road, the fulfilment flow is yours: order intake, dispatch, pickup, driving, customer handover. You will take it apart, make it measurable, watch it in real time, and drive the fixes. You will lead a team of 2–3. Expect to firefight. Early-stage operations break in ways nobody has documented yet, and you will need to contain problems fast, often on incomplete information. But every incident should leave behind a standard, a monitor, or a fix — we will judge you on how fast you contain today’s problem, and on how few of them you are still containing three months in. What You’ll Own On-time delivery rate, fulfilment success rate, vehicle utilisation, exception rate and MTTR — the numbers this role is measured on. Fulfilment standards and SOPs that our field and service teams run on. Real-time monitoring and the escalation model — with a documented root cause for every major failure. Turning field problems into prioritised, evidence-backed asks for product and engineering — and following through until the metric moves. What You’ll Need Essential 3–5 years in last-mile delivery, on-demand logistics, ride-hailing, quick commerce or fleet operations. Proven ability to build process, not just run it — you have taken a messy operation, decomposed it, and made it repeatable by others. This matters more to us than years of management. A metric you personally moved , and the story of how. SQL and BI — you pull and cut your own data rather than queuing behind an analyst. Skilled with AI tools — you build your own dashboards, analyses or prototypes instead of waiting on someone else. A track record of driving fixes through teams you don’t manage . Hands-on operating experience in the UAE or wider GCC . Fluent English; based in Abu Dhabi or ready to relocate. Preferred Autonomous vehicle, delivery robot or teleoperation background. Arabic. Team leadership experience. Zero-to-one market launch. What We Offer Competitive package benchmarked to the UAE market. Company-provided AI tool subscriptions. Visa sponsored. Ownership of UAE fulfilment performance in a business building autonomous delivery operations from zero — very few companies in the region are doing this — with a team of 2–3 from day one. This is an early-stage business: frequent problems, fast pace, processes still being written. If that is the environment you do your best work in, this role will give you more of it than most. results.description: Job Summary: The role will lead and manage P&L, operations, and business growth for trucking fleets and lead teams, win new business, improve network safety, and ensure high on-time delivery rates across the GCC network Key Responsibilities Commercial Accountability Grow revenue and gross margin for the road freight division. Build pricing models and bid strategies for new customer contracts. Secure new business and keep key client accounts happy. Work with sales teams to pitch integrated 3PL solutions. results.title: Director of Logistics
results.description: Logistics Director – Saudi Arabia A leading organisation is seeking an experienced Logistics Director to oversee and lead all logistics operations for a major, high-profile development project in Saudi Arabia. This is a senior, site-based leadership position responsible for developing and implementing the overall logistics strategy and ensuring the efficient movement of people, materials, equipment, vehicles, and resources across the project. The role will operate on a hybrid basis between Riyadh and the project site , with a strong site presence required to manage day-to-day logistics activities and coordinate closely with project leadership, contractors, consultants, and key stakeholders. Key Responsibilities Provide strategic leadership and overall direction for all project logistics and site logistics operations . Develop, implement, and continuously improve the project-wide logistics strategy, plans, procedures, and control systems . Oversee the movement, delivery, storage, and distribution of construction materials, plant, equipment, and other resources. Manage site access, traffic management, vehicle movements, laydown areas, storage facilities, delivery scheduling, and logistics compounds . Coordinate logistics requirements across multiple contractors, consultants, suppliers, and project teams to minimise disruption and maximise site efficiency. Establish effective systems for delivery management, material flow, site transportation, and resource allocation . Work closely with construction, engineering, procurement, commercial, HSE, security, and programme teams to ensure logistics activities align with overall project requirements. Monitor logistics performance, identify potential constraints and bottlenecks, and implement proactive solutions to maintain programme progress. Lead the planning and coordination of logistics requirements during different phases of construction and project development. Ensure all logistics activities comply with relevant HSE requirements, Saudi regulations, project standards, and operational procedures . Manage logistics-related risks, developing mitigation strategies and contingency plans where required. Provide regular reporting to senior project leadership on logistics performance, risks, constraints, resource requirements, and upcoming activities. Lead and develop logistics teams, promoting a strong culture of collaboration, accountability, safety, and continuous improvement. Liaise with local authorities, transport providers, suppliers, and other external stakeholders where required. Support the wider project leadership team in resolving complex logistical challenges and ensuring the project remains on programme. Candidate Profile The successful candidate will be a highly experienced Logistics Director / Senior Logistics Manager with a strong background in major construction, infrastructure, urban development, or mega-project environments. Experience managing logistics across large and complex sites, with multiple contractors and significant volumes of people, materials, and equipment, is highly desirable. The individual should demonstrate: Significant senior-level experience in construction and project logistics . Proven experience developing and implementing logistics strategies for large-scale projects. Strong understanding of site logistics, traffic management, material handling, access management, and supply-chain coordination . Excellent leadership and stakeholder-management capabilities. Strong commercial awareness and an ability to manage logistics efficiently within programme and budget constraints. Excellent communication, planning, problem-solving, and decision-making skills. The ability to operate confidently at both strategic and operational levels . Experience working in Saudi Arabia or the wider GCC would be advantageous. Location & Benefits This is a hybrid role , with the successful candidate working between Riyadh and the project site in Saudi Arabia . A regular and significant site presence will be required due to the operational nature of the position. When working on site, the package includes: Site allowance payable for time spent on site. Flights between Riyadh and the relevant site location. Hotel accommodation when required. Accommodation and transportation provided in connection with the site assignment. Opportunity to work on a major, high-profile development programme in Saudi Arabia.

results.description: In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities. Imagine Next! At Parsons, you can imagine a career where you thrive, work with exceptional people, and be yourself. Guided by our leadership vision of valuing people, embracing agility, and fostering growth, we cultivate an innovative culture that empowers you to achieve your full potential. Unleash your talent and redefine what’s possible. Job Description **Join a Landmark Giga-Project Shaping the Future of Saudi Arabia** Our client is delivering one of the Kingdom’s most ambitious and high-profile giga-projects, set to redefine global standards in destination development, innovation, and visitor experience. As part of the integrated Delivery Partner team, you will play a key role in planning, designing, and implementing world-class assets and infrastructure that support the Kingdom’s Vision 2030. This is a unique opportunity to contribute to a pioneering program at scale, working alongside industry-leading experts, cutting-edge technologies, and diverse stakeholders. If you are driven by challenge, motivated by impact, and eager to be part of a legacy project that will influence generations to come, we invite you to consider joining this transformative journey. The Senior Director: Mobility Planner is the ultimate technical, operational, and strategic authority responsible for the end-to-end planning, efficiency, and day-to-day management of the city’s multi-modal mobility network. With a mandate requiring extensive distinguished leadership experience, this executive-level leader oversees the live operations of the entire transportation ecosystem. This includes public transit systems, autonomous shuttle corridors, active mobility trails, parking networks, micro-mobility, and intelligent traffic management systems. Sitting firmly within the O&M division, this role focuses on maximizing network throughput, minimizing congestion, deploying next-generation smart-city mobility technologies, and ensuring safe, seamless, and sustainable journeys for millions of annual residents and visitors. Key Responsibilities Multi-Modal Network & Transit Operations (O&M) Direct the daily operations, transit scheduling, and fleet management of all public and private transportation systems, including buses, light rail/monorail, micro-mobility, and autonomous mass transit networks. Oversee the strategic implementation of active mobility frameworks, managing pedestrian corridors, bike networks, and scooter-sharing infrastructure to ensure perfect connectivity between major city hubs and entertainment districts. Serve as the principal authority for high-footfall event transport planning, designing mega-crowd traffic diversion models, park-and-ride strategies, and flexible transit surges to handle peak visitor loads seamlessly. Formulate robust emergency transportation plans, network redundancy routes, and incident-response protocols to guarantee zero-disruption mobility during grid failures or civil emergencies. Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) & Traffic Engineering Direct the operational deployment and tuning of the city's Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS), including adaptive traffic signals, automated speed enforcement, and real-time transit information displays. Partner with the digital city operations hub to leverage real-time traffic flow telemetry, predictive AI congestion mapping, and IoT sensor loops to optimize vehicle movements city-wide. Act as the technical authority for the city's smart car parks, integrating automated parking guidance systems (PGS), automated billing, license plate recognition (LPR), and electric vehicle (EV) charging grids with the broader mobility network. Financial Cost Recovery & Asset Integration Translate multi-modal usage logs, public transit ticketing data, and shared mobility fees into automated financial models for corporate finance teams. Provide the Service Charge Director with audited transit-wear metrics to ensure equitable infrastructure cross-charging, charging commercial zones, theme parks, and venues their fair share for the mobility infrastructure feeding their districts. Collaborate with the Asset Lifecycle Planning (LCP) division to map out multi-decade Capital Asset Replacement Plans (CARP) for core mobility infrastructure (e.g., transit fleets, smart charging arrays, signals, and ITS servers). Partner with the SAP-EAMS team to ensure every vehicle, charging dock, traffic sensor, and transit station is assigned a flawless digital ID for data-driven, predictive maintenance scheduling. Stage-Gate Handover & Design Advisory Serve as the primary mobility gatekeeper on the Stage-Gate Handover Committee, auditing traffic impact assessments (TIAs) and multi-modal readiness before newly constructed transit corridors or roads transition into live city operations. Formulate rigorous testing and commissioning verification rules for all transit fleets and smart ITS software networks prior to full operational adoption from builders and vendors. Job Requirements & Qualifications Education & Professional Credentials Bachelor’s Degree in Transportation Planning, Civil Engineering, Urban Design, Traffic Engineering, or a highly relevant quantitative technical discipline from an accredited institution. Master’s Degree in Transportation Engineering, Smart Mobility, Urban Planning, or an MBA from a globally recognized institution is highly preferred. Professional Certifications: Active senior professional registration, such as a Chartered Engineer (CEng), Professional Engineer (PE), or certification from the American Institute of Certified Planners (AICP) / Institute of Transportation Engineers (ITE). Experience 20+ years of progressive, distinguished leadership experience in multi-modal urban transit planning, large-scale traffic engineering, or smart city mobility operations. At least 8 years in a senior executive or director-level capacity, directly managing multi-disciplinary transport teams and multi-million-dollar mobility operational and capital budgets (OPEX/CAPEX). Proven track record of spearheading the operational setup, network routing, or post-construction integration of giga-scale mass transit networks, autonomous vehicle testbeds, or smart-city traffic frameworks. Deep experience navigating micro-mobility logistics, fleet electrification challenges, demand-side traffic management, and Saudi Arabia's Vision 2030 sustainability and smart city targets. Executive-level fluency in transport operational technologies, including fleet telematics, automated fare collection (AFC) engines, and SAP Enterprise Asset Management (EAMS) integrations. results.title: Operations Manager - Vehicle Distribution | Al-Futtaim Automotive | Logistics | Riyadh
results.description: Job Requisition ID: 180125 Established in the 1930s as a trading business, Al-Futtaim Group today is one of the most diversified and progressive, privately held regional businesses headquartered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Structured into five operating divisions; automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and healthcare; employing more than 35,000 employees across more than 20 countries in the Middle East, Asia and Africa, Al-Futtaim Group partners with over 200 of the world's most admired and innovative brands. Al-Futtaim Group’s entrepreneurship and relentless customer focus enables the organization to continue to grow and expand; responding to the changing needs of our customers within the societies in which we operate. By upholding our values of respect, excellence, collaboration and integrity; Al-Futtaim Group continues to enrich the lives and aspirations of our customers each and every day Overview Of The Role: The role requires ensuring compliance with customs and port authorities as well as adhering to KSA regulatory requirements. Key responsibilities include warehousing, documentation, port clearance, and ensuring prompt deliveries across various dealer locations in KSA to achieve optimal customer satisfaction and business targets. Success in this role involves on-time supply and delivery at minimal cost, maintaining budgeted net contribution through strategic cost management, and fostering strong relationships with customers and regulatory bodies. What You Will Do: Ensure strict, accurate, and timely management reporting to provide visibility of daily operational performance, achievements, and trends. Update KPI dashboards and operational reports for management review through SAP systems. Develop, implement, and maintain SOPs for all logistics and supply chain activities within the division. Ensure SOPs are in place for all supply chain activities to standardize procedures. Monitor financial targets through monthly P&L review. Achieve Net Profit budget through strict cost control and monitoring financial dimensions. Maintain strong relationships with customers by providing proactive communication, advice, and operational feedback. Engage with customers regularly via email, calls, online Teams calls, and face-to-face contacts. Ensure timely delivery of vehicles and customer requirements across all showrooms, dealer, and distributor locations in KSA. Ensure all vehicle movements within the premises adhere to strict compliance with safety and relevant quality standards. Formulate and finalize SLAs with customers and negotiate with suppliers aligned with business objectives. Collaborate with management to prepare and sign SLAs and contracts with customers and suppliers, regularly reviewing performance. Conduct staff performance appraisals and development reviews in line with company regulations. Implement PDR techniques for staff development both half-yearly and yearly. Required Skills To Be Successful: Strong knowledge of SAP and relevant computer applications. Organizational skills to manage logistics efficiently. Ability to make informed decisions under pressure. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills for customer and team interactions. What Qualifies You For The Role: Degree in any discipline from a recognized institution. At least 7 years of relevant experience in operations management or a related field. Proficiency in SAP and computer applications with a strong understanding of logistics processes. Excellent organizational, decision-making, and interpersonal skills. About Al-Futtaim Automotive A major division of the UAE-based Al-Futtaim Group of companies, Al-Futtaim Automotive is an industry leader with presence in 10 countries across the Middle East, Asia and Africa. Our core business activities at Al-Futtaim Automotive include distribution, manufacturing, leasing and aftersales, and we are firmly established as the regional representative of some of the world’s most iconic automotive brands: Toyota, Lexus, Honda, Jeep, Chrysler, Dodge, Volvo and RAM. We are driven by a customer-centric approach, constantly pushing the boundaries on innovation, quality standards, and value-added service across our vast universe of customers - right from motoring enthusiasts to fleet operators to contractors. Our mission is to become the leader in custom-made mobility solutions by delivering nothing less than world-class omni-channel experiences. We channel our local expertise and global trust to deliver one of the most comprehensive portfolios of mobility products and solutions, from passenger cars to SUVs, electric vehicles to high-performance motorbikes, commercial vehicles to industrial & construction equipment. What keeps the company moving forward is a 9000-member strong team, with inspiring possibilities for growth, throughout the career path. This is Al-Futtaim Automotive and we empower talent to move forward.

Excellent negotiation and stakeholder management capability. Deep understanding of airfreight operations and global market dynamics. Ability to balance operational execution with strategic growth. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Preferred Skills IATA certification. Experience in the Middle East market. Exposure to specialized cargo segments.
